On the Same Tender results page you will see that there is an account number and a customer full name

Then you go to Action and Export to Excel. I also have the button green for 'Override limit and export all results

When you open up the Excel file it is missing the columns for Account Number and Customer Full Name

set cardno = 'tOTEofGFdQ5IuwrF';

SELECT
T1.transactionid AS "transactionid",
T4.Value AS "header_stdtransactiontype",
T1.EndTransDateTime AS "endtransdatetime",
T1.StoreNo AS "storeno",
T1.posno AS "posno",
T1.ticketno AS "ticketno",
T1.CashierNo AS "cashierno",
T1.TicketAmount AS "ticketamount",
T2.AccountNumber AS "tender_accountnumber",
T3.CustomerFullName AS "customer_customerfullname"
FROM ardm_Header AS T1
LEFT JOIN ardm_Tender AS T2
\tON (T1.TransactionID = T2.TransactionID AND T1.TradingDay = T2.TradingDay)
LEFT JOIN ardm_Customer AS T3
\tON (T1.TransactionID = T3.TransactionID AND T1.TradingDay = T3.TradingDay)
LEFT JOIN secure_EnumerationReferenceData AS T4
\tON (T4.EnumerationType = 'headerstdtransactiontype' AND T4.Culture = 'en-US' AND T4.KeyAsInt = T1.StdTransactionType)
WHERE
(
(T1.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-04T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-04-03T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(T2.AccountNumber = $cardno)
LIMIT 1000

Root Cause Identified

The Account # and Customer Full Name columns are blank in the Excel export due to an incorrect data-type attribute on two DisplayField elements in Urban's Same Tender Card search definition
(repo/44/system/ebr/smarttracksearches/sametendercard.search).

Both fields are declared as data-type="System.Double" when they should be System.String:

  • tender_accountnumber (Account #)

  • customer_customerfullname (Customer Full Name)

All other clients with these fields (e.g. clients 57, 138) correctly declare them as System.String, and they are exporting these values correctly.

Why it only affects the Excel export and not the UI: The browser grid renders values as raw strings regardless of the declared data-type, so Account # and Customer Full Name display correctly on screen. The
Excel writer uses the data-type to cast values before writing to the xlsx — when it tries to cast a masked card number or a customer name to System.Double, the conversion fails and the cell is written as
blank.

Fix: Change data-type="System.Double" to data-type="System.String" for both tender_accountnumber and customer_customerfullname display fields in repo/44/system/ebr/smarttracksearches/sametendercard.search.

Below is a screenshot of client 57 with the correct data types, exporting correctly

Hi Tim,

I wanted to provide you with an update on this issue.

Our team has completed the root cause analysis — the Account # and Customer Full Name columns are blank in the Excel export due to an data-type configuration in the Same Tender Card search definition. The fields are currently set as numeric types when they should be text, which causes the Excel writer to produce blank cells even though the data displays correctly on screen.

The team is reviewing this and we will keep you updated as we progress.

Thanks,

BJ Probert
Customer Support Engineer
